results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: One-Shot Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation with Interactive Replay
results.snippet: Recently, model-free reinforcement learning algorithms have been shown to solve challenging problems by learning from extensive interaction with the environment. A significant issue with transferring this success to the robotics domain is that interaction with the real world is costly, but training on limited experience is prone to overfitting. We present a method for learning to navigate, to a fixed goal and in a known environment, on a mobile robot. The robot leverages an interactive world model built from a single traversal of the environment, a pre-trained visual feature encoder, and stoc…

results.title: Real-Time Whole-Body Control of Legged Robots with Model-Predictive Path Integral Control
results.snippet: This paper presents a system for enabling real-time synthesis of whole-body locomotion and manipulation policies for real-world legged robots. Motivated by recent advancements in robot simulation, we leverage the efficient parallelization capabilities of the MuJoCo simulator to achieve fast sampling over the robot state and action trajectories. Our results show surprisingly effective real-world locomotion and manipulation capabilities with a very simple control strategy. We demonstrate our approach on several hardware and simulation experiments: robust locomotion over flat and uneven terrains…

results.title: BEHAVIOR Robot Suite: Streamlining Real-World Whole-Body Manipulation for Everyday Household Activities
results.snippet: Real-world household tasks present significant challenges for mobile manipulation robots. An analysis of existing robotics benchmarks reveals that successful task performance hinges on three key whole-body control capabilities: bimanual coordination, stable and precise navigation, and extensive end-effector reachability. Achieving these capabilities requires careful hardware design, but the resulting system complexity further complicates visuomotor policy learning. To address these challenges, we introduce the BEHAVIOR Robot Suite (BRS), a comprehensive framework for whole-body manipulation i…

results.snippet: Co-simulation is a critical approach for the design and analysis of complex cyber-physical systems. It will enhance development efficiency and reduce costs. results.title: On Controller Design for Systems on Manifolds in Euclidean Space
results.snippet: A new method is developed to design controllers in Euclidean space for systems defined on manifolds. The idea is to embed the state-space manifold $M$ of a given control system into some Euclidean space $\mathbb R^n$, extend the system from $M$ to the ambient space $\mathbb R^n$, and modify it outside $M$ to add transversal stability to $M$ in the final dynamics in $\mathbb R^n$. Controllers are designed for the final system in the ambient space $\mathbb R^n$. Then, their restriction to $M$ produces controllers for the original system on $M$. This method has the merit that only one single glo…

report_md:
# 机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 生态前沿调研报告

**日期**：2026-11-01 | **领域**：具身智能 / 机器人运动学与控制 / ROS 2 生态 | **检索源数量**：32 条（其中高相关性 5 条：[10, 11, 22, 23, 24]）

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 近 1-2 年核心突破（增量进展）

| 名称 | 年份 | 机构/来源 | 热度证据 | 权威证据 | 关注度 | 推荐度 | 链接 | 说明 |
|------|------|-----------|----------|----------|--------|--------|------|------|
| Real-Time Whole-Body Control with MPPI | 2024 | arXiv [10] | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本，引用数/Star 未提供） | arXiv 预印本 (cs.RO)，非同行评审 | 中（真机全身 MPC 热点方向） | ★★★★☆ | [10] | 基于 MuJoCo 并行采样的 MPPI 实现腿足机器人实时全身运动与操作策略合成，真机验证有效 |
| BEHAVIOR Robot Suite | 2025 | arXiv [11] | > 待核实（2025 新发布，引用/下载未提供） | arXiv 预印本 (cs.RO)，非同行评审 | 中（真机移动操作基准建设热点） | ★★★★☆ | [11] | 系统定义真机家庭任务对全身控制的三大核心需求：双臂协调、稳定导航、大范围可达性，推动软硬件协同设计 |
| ROS 2 + Simulink 协同仿真框架 | 2025 | arXiv [23] | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本，工程落地案例） | arXiv 预印本 (eess.SY)，非同行评审 | 中（ROS 2 工程集成关注点） | ★★★☆☆ | [23] | 面向四旋翼的分层控制（LQR+PID）与跨平台数据交换工程实现细节 |

**核心增量判断**：
- **全身 MPC 真机化**：MPPI 结合仿真器并行采样（MuJoCo）已在腿足本体上实现实时全身控制真机部署 [10]，标志着基于采样的 MPC 从仿真走向真机的关键一步。
- **基准向真机长时程演进**：BEHAVIOR Robot Suite [11] 将评测焦点从单技能转向「日常家庭活动」长时程任务，明确提出双臂协调、精准导航、广泛可达性三大全身控制硬指标，倒逼控制栈向软硬件协同设计演进。
- **ROS 2 工程链路补强**：ROS 2 与 MATLAB/Simulink 协同仿真框架 [23] 落地分层控制架构，填补了模型设计到代码部署的工程链路空白。

> 待核实：上述三项工作均为 arXiv 预印本，缺乏同行评审背书、第三方复现报告及引用/Star 等热度量化指标，工程成熟度与社区采纳度需持续跟踪。

---

## 2. 工业界与产品

### 2.1 产品化与落地信号

| 信号 | 时间 | 来源 | 证据等级 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|----------|------|
| ROS 2 与商业仿真工具链深度绑定 | 2025 | [23] | B (arXiv 预印本) | 学术界已验证 ROS 2 + Simulink 协同仿真可行性，预示工业界模型基于设计流程向 ROS 2 迁移加速 |
| 真机家庭任务基准驱动硬件标准化 | 2025 | [11] | B (arXiv 预印本) | BEHAVIOR Suite 强调「软硬件协同设计」，可能推动灵巧手/移动底盘标准化接口与全身控制器产品化 |

**判断**：
- 当前检索证据**无直接覆盖**头部机器人公司（Boston Dynamics, Figure, 1X, Agility 等）最新产品发布、量产节点或商业化部署数据。
- ROS 2 Control 框架在工业级控制器（如 ros2_control 在工业机械臂、移动底盘的量产案例）缺乏一手公开来源。
> 待核实：工业界真机全身控制器产品化进度、ROS 2 Control 在量产机型上的采纳率、商业仿真软件对 ROS 2 实时控制的原生支持程度。

---

## 3. 蓝海与缺口

### 3.1 未解问题与无人区（基于现有证据梳理）

| 蓝海方向 | 缺口描述 | 证据来源 | 优先级 |
|----------|----------|----------|--------|
| **高维全身控制实时求解器** | MPPI 类方法在灵巧手/双臂协作（>30 DoF）下的采样效率与实时性瓶颈，缺乏通用加速库 | [10] (Open Problems) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **Sim-to-Real 接触动力学 Gap** | 仿真并行采样到真机部署的接触建模误差补偿，缺乏系统性基准与自适应方案 | [10] (Open Problems) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **长时程任务的全身控制闭环** | 感知-规划-控制在非结构化家庭环境下的鲁棒集成，BEHAVIOR Suite 仅定义指标未给解法 | [11] | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **ROS 2 Control 核心架构文档缺失** | 缺乏从 ROS 1 到 ROS 2 Control 架构演进、硬件抽象层设计、实时执行器语义的权威教科书级文献 | [22] (q2 Open Problems) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
